name: @imajin/openclaw-infer-passthrough
description: Local OpenAI-compatible HTTP proxy (imajin-ai#1926, Phase 4 of the #1922 inference connectors epic): mints kernel app-token JWTs on OpenClaw's behalf and forwards custom-provider completions calls to POST /infer/v1/chat/completions, with break-glass direct fallback on kernel 5xx/timeout.
